fact: GRA says it maintains a Taxpayer Identification Numbering System under the Revenue Administration Act 2016, issues TINs to organisations at its offices, and offers an online TIN/Ghana Card PIN verification portal.

GRA says its TIN Centre is co-located at the Registrar-General's Department as a one-stop shop issuing the organisation's TIN during business registration, and organisations register for TIN only after registering with the RGD.
GRA says that from 1 April 2021 the Ghana Card PIN issued by the National Identification Authority replaces the GRA-issued TIN for individual taxpayers.
